trap-rhetorical-pivot.evidence: Full read of the conjecture. RECOMPUTED all five coefficients with mpmath at the proton pin (q0=1.1099785827513808, m_e=0.51099895 MeV, [n]_q=(q^n-q^-n)/(q-q^-1)): Volume 2[2][7]m_e=15.6711 (claimed 15.67), Surface 2[4]^2 m_e=17.2610 (17.26), Coulomb (q-q^-1)[6]m_e=0.68244 (0.68), Asymmetry 3[2][7]m_e=23.5066 (23.51), Pairing [3][7]m_e=11.8599 (11.86). All five reproduce, and identically at the muon pin. Internal ratio asymmetry/volume=3/2 is exact by construction. Two substantive defects recorded separately (undelivered 'two Hecke-derived extensions'; the Coulomb term is not a product of quantum integers). No trap of this category.

trap-superlative.evidence: Two unqualified absolutes, both contradicted by the block's own list. (1) 'emerge strictly as products of quantum integers [n]_q' - the third bullet is (q-q^-1)[6]_q, and q-q^-1 is NOT a quantum integer ([2]_q = q+q^-1, and q-q^-1 is the normalising denominator, not any [n]_q). (2) 'We predict binding energies without empirical inputs.' - every one of the five coefficients is multiplied by m_e, which is CAL-1, and q0 is itself pinned on an experimental mass ratio; the coefficients are therefore m_e-scaled, not input-free.
trap-superlative.notes: Proposed (structural, meaning at stake - not applied): (1) 'emerge as products of quantum integers [n]_q and the normaliser (q - q^{-1})'. (2) replace the final sentence with 'The coefficients then carry no free parameter beyond the three calibrations (m_e sets the MeV scale; q0 is pinned by CAL-2).'
